description: Download prepared log data for a request_id (must be status="processed"; check logs_status). Default mode "sample" returns up to maxRows parsed rows inline — cheap and bounded. Mode "file" streams the FULL export to a file and returns its path plus a small preview; the raw content (potentially millions of rows) is never loaded into context. Read-only.

counterId.description: Yandex Metrica counter id. Optional if YANDEX_METRIKA_COUNTER_ID is configured.

maxRows.description: sample mode only: max rows to return inline (default 100, max 1000).

mode.description: sample (default): return up to maxRows parsed rows inline — cheap, bounded, no file. file: stream the FULL export to a file and return its path plus a small preview.

outputPath.description: file mode only: absolute path to write the export to. Defaults to a file in the configured logs directory.

requestId.description: Log request id returned by logs_request.

name: logs_download
title: Download Metrica raw logs
